exact_reassociations.promotion: retain right-branch XOR as a cross-architecture/target-timing diagnostic; do not replace the Intel target candidate from static evidence
exact_reassociations.result: All four preserve 122 instructions, zero hot memory, and the 549-byte floor. Only right-branch XOR changes proxy scheduling, and its gain is absent from both Intel target proxies.

right_branch_xor.result: Moving the constant XOR onto the right-shift branch keeps Alder Lake and Meteor Lake at 100.03 cycles, but reduces the Zen 2 cross-architecture proxy from 180.03 to 160.03.

high_state_encoding_dual.promotion: No strict static win over the retained low-state stream; keep as a target-timing/register-allocation alternative rather than replacing the source.
high_state_encoding_dual.result: All three high-state cases are 549 bytes, 122 instructions, and zero hot memory. VEX2 carries the high state in vvvv/destination while low scratch and XOR/add constants occupy ModRM r/m.

lower_bound.qualification: This is an encoding floor for the current six-instruction transform and SUB/JNE outer loop, not an algorithmic lower bound.

allocator_scratch_case.reason: allocator places scratch high, lengthening only the 20 VPOR encodings

wrong_modrm_case.reason: putting high state in ModRM lengthens VPOR, VPXOR, and VPADDQ in every transform

overconstrained_fixed_map.result: Pinning every inverted register class forces one constant reload and one reverse permute into the hot loop; relaxed high-state/low-scratch pinning avoids it.

source_controlled_placement.promotion: Requires repeated target-core timing; no placement is promoted from static evidence.
source_controlled_placement.result: All linked placements retain the exact 549-byte normalized stream. Their recorded 16/32/64-byte crossing geometry is real, but llvm-mca strips linked addresses and cannot rank front-end boundary effects.

model_limits.host_timing: No host timing is collected; exact 255H core-type timing is required for any promotion.
model_limits.llvm_mca: LLVM-MCA 16 Alder Lake and Zen 2 are scheduling proxies. They do not model Core Ultra 7 255H P/E/LP-E cores or linked fetch/decode boundary placement.
